title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.10232v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent world-action models (WAMs) show that co-training policies with future prediction can provide physical priors for action generation. Building on the future-prediction ability of video models, many WAMs generate future videos and recover actions with inverse-dynamics models, or use these predicted videos as goal conditions for action generation. In both cases, the world model is trained mostly on successful demonstrations and has little reason to predict the consequences of bad actions. We introduce FACT, a causal World-Action Model that predicts future video and task progress conditioned on the executed action. This action-conditioned interface allows failure rollouts to supervise action consequences, turning bad actions into valid future targets rather than being discarded. Failure-aware training makes the progress predictor aware of both successful and failed action outcomes, which can optionally be used to score sample

translated_title: FACT：面向世界-动作模型的失败感知因果训练
translated_abstract: 近期的世界-动作模型表明，将策略与未来预测进行联合训练可以为动作生成提供物理先验。基于视频模型的未来预测能力，许多世界-动作模型通过生成未来视频并借助逆动力学模型恢复动作，或将这些预测视频用作动作生成的目标条件。在这两种情况下，世界模型主要在成功演示的数据上训练，几乎没有理由去预测不良动作的后果。我们提出了FACT，这是一个因果世界-动作模型，它以执行的动作条件预测未来视频和任务进度。这种以动作为条件的接口使得失败轨迹能够监督动作后果，将坏动作转化为有效的未来预测目标，而不是被直接丢弃。失败感知训练使进度预测器能够同时感知成功和失败的动作结果，这可以选择性地用于对样本进行评分（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: FACT提出了一种失败感知的因果训练方法，让世界-动作模型以执行动作为条件预测未来视频和任务进度，从而利用失败轨迹监督动作后果，将失败数据转化为有效的训练信号而非被丢弃。
